scope: Local draft only; not installed in Production or a database copy
input_contract: A precomputed sentence with analysis.language_graph from the unchanged runtime-structural-v1.37 pipeline
execution_contract: Check exact shadow-release membership, inclusion in existing pilot_rule_codes, compiled hash and one live grant, then call existing execute_dependency_pattern_rule_v2 exactly once for subject_of_predicate
grant_contract: Append-only grant and revocation events; no matching grant, two live grants or a hash mismatch fails closed
p1_test_cases: On a disposable database copy, load the R051 source-backed Katten sover sentence and matching release/rule rows
With one valid grant, compare the selector's jsonb output with the subject_of_predicate item from build_rule_execution_plane_v1 on the identical precomputed sentence
With no grant, confirm PILOT_GRANT_INVALID and no rule execution
With an incorrect compiled hash, confirm PILOT_GRANT_INVALID and no rule execution
With two live grants, confirm PILOT_GRANT_INVALID and no rule execution
After a revocation event, confirm PILOT_GRANT_INVALID and no rule execution
Confirm anon and authenticated cannot use the dedicated schema or function
limitations: SQL draft has not been parsed or executed against PostgreSQL
The current environment has no local PostgreSQL or Docker runtime
App output isolation, monitoring and Production deployment remain separate gates
